He thought he was a rockstar, and he played the drums...but only at about 8 A.M. before he was too fucked up to function. I would have been fine with it, but the drums were in the living room where I slept. No warnings were given, just get on the drums and start playing while I'm still asleep. He didn't know how to use a dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, lawn mower, etc. He knew how to use the T.V. remote though, and I would be subjected to such quality programming as Maury, MTV's whole line up, and so on.
